title: Work order link from another location: Cancel returns to Work Orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • You work at locations A and B and are at A.
  • You have a link to a work order at location B (for example from a note-mention email).
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order link in the browser.
  2. Read the prompt.
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Read the page and the message.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 2:

  • "Switch location?" asking to switch to location B.

Step 4:

  • you are on the work order list and the message reads "Switch cancelled. Returning to work orders."

Why this matters: The shared switch prompt was reworked for the aging reports.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/composables/useWorkOrderLocationResolver.ts:43-46. V1 code, quoted: `cancelMessage = 'Switch cancelled. Returning to work orders.', fallbackRouteName = 'WorkOrders',`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-204) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
